params.1273: Given by Sir Kay in Camelot Castle for completing all Hard Tasks in Seers' Village.
params.1292: Seers' headband 3 and a magic lamp worth 10,000xp in a skill of your choice. The coal trucks at the Seers' Village coal mine will now hold 196 coal.
params.1274: The headband gains the following extra benefits:
params.1275: - Thormac at the Sorcerer's Tower will enchant mystic staves for 27,000 coins instead of 40,000.
params.1276: - The Lady of the Lake will enhance Excalibur for you.
params.1277: Talk to any seer to change your Camelot Teleport destination to the centre of Seers' Village.
params.1278: The Seers' Village altar will give a +2 boost to Prayer.
params.1279: Geoffrey in the flax field near Seers' Village will give you 120 flax per day.
